actions.label: Read the screen
actions.description: Read the front app, or the named app, as elements with the actions that make sense on it right now.
actions.agent: Read the screen of the front app, or of the named app, and the actions it accepts. Read-only.

app.label: App
app.description: The app to read. Defaults to the front app.

layer.label: Layer
layer.description: Which layer reads the screen: auto, the accessibility tree (ax) or pixels.

diff.label: Diff
diff.description: Show only what changed since the last read.

elements.label: Elements
elements.description: JSON: the screen's elements and the actions each accepts.

actions.label: Check the gate
actions.description: Check whether an agent may touch this screen now: unlocked, and nobody has used it for the idle time.
actions.agent: Say whether the screen is open to an agent right now, and why not if it is not. Read-only.

action.label: Action
action.description: check, wait, init, pre, post or show.

idle.label: Idle seconds
idle.description: How long nobody must have used the Mac.

maxMin.label: Wait at most
maxMin.description: With wait: how many minutes to wait at most.

open.label: Open
open.description: True when an agent may touch the screen now.

why.label: Why
why.description: The reason the gate is open or shut.

actions.label: Check this Mac
actions.description: See what this Mac has for hackamore: the agent, the grant, the gate, the config and the next step if something is missing.
actions.agent: Report what this Mac has for hackamore and the next step if something is missing. Read-only.

ok.label: Ready
ok.description: True when the Accessibility grant is in place.

actions.label: Run one action on an app
actions.description: Run one action (click, set_value, type_text, press_key, menu, scroll, perform, open_app, activate) on an app and get the screen after it.
actions.agent: Run one action on an app on this Mac, which other people may see, and read the screen after it. A person says yes first.

action.label: Action
action.description: The action to run, as ls lists it.

inputJson.label: Input
inputJson.description: The action's input as a JSON object.

app.label: App
app.description: The app to act on. Defaults to the front app.

idle.label: Idle seconds
idle.description: Refuse unless nobody has used the Mac for this many seconds.

record.label: Record to
record.description: Write the step to this file, for a journey.

diff.label: Diff
diff.description: Show only what changed after the action.

state.label: State
state.description: ok, failed or refused, and the screen after the action.

actions.label: Run many actions on an app
actions.description: Run many steps on an app in one call; the run stops at the first refusal or unmet check.
actions.agent: Run a list of steps on an app on this Mac, which other people may see. A person says yes first.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: A JSON array of {action, input, until?, app?} steps.

app.label: App
app.description: The app to act on by default.

idle.label: Idle seconds
idle.description: Refuse unless nobody has used the Mac for this many seconds.

record.label: Record to
record.description: Write the steps to this file, for a journey.

diff.label: Diff
diff.description: Show only what changed after the last step.

state.label: State
state.description: ok, failed or refused, and the screen after the last step run.

actions.label: Replay a recorded journey
actions.description: Replay a journey recorded with --record as one batch.
actions.agent: Replay a recorded journey of steps on an app on this Mac, which other people may see. A person says yes first.

file.label: Journey file
file.description: A JSON file of recorded steps.

state.label: State
state.description: ok, failed or refused, and the screen after the last step run.

actions.label: Look after the resident agent
actions.description: Say whether the resident Ouro Reins Agent that holds the Accessibility grant is running; with a word, build it, install it, or raise the grant dialog (only with a person at the Mac).
actions.agent: Say whether the resident Ouro Reins Agent is running; install and build change only this Mac, and grant needs a person at it.

from.label: From
from.description: With install: the folder to install from.

force.label: Force
force.description: With install: replace what is installed.

developerId.label: Developer ID
developerId.description: With build: sign with a Developer ID certificate.

personHere.label: Person here
personHere.description: With grant: only with a person at the Mac.

running.label: Running
running.description: True when the resident agent is running.

actions.label: Serve one request for another Mac
actions.description: Serve one request: read a JSON line from stdin and print the reply line. This is what --via runs on the other Mac.
actions.agent: Serve one JSON request line from stdin for another Mac that drives this one with --via, which other people may see. A person says yes first.

state.label: State
state.description: The reply line: its code, its reply and the screen.
